## Animato v1.7.4 — Dioxus Desktop Animation Loop Fix

Animato v1.7.4 is a focused patch release that fixes
[#57](https://github.com/AarambhDevHub/animato/issues/57): on dioxus-desktop
every animato-dioxus hook (`use_tween`, `use_spring`, `use_timeline`,
`use_keyframes`, plus `use_motion` and `use_drag`) froze the window. The
native animation loop called `std::thread::sleep` inside an async block
without ever awaiting, so the future never yielded and blocked the Dioxus
executor and UI thread — the window opened, then showed "Not Responding"
with near-zero CPU because the thread was sleeping, not spinning.

### Highlights

- **Non-blocking frame pacing.** The native loop now awaits
  `futures_timer::Delay` (~16 ms) between frames instead of
  `std::thread::sleep`. The dioxus 0.7.9 source shows dioxus-desktop polls
  the VirtualDom with a plain tao waker outside any tokio runtime
  (`webview.rs::poll_vdom`), so a `tokio::time::sleep` timer would have
  panicked at runtime; `futures-timer` is runtime-agnostic and works under
  any executor. The dependency is native-target-only — wasm32 keeps the
  requestAnimationFrame loop and gains no new dependencies.
- **Loops park when idle.** Each hook previously returned `true`
  unconditionally from its loop closure, so completed tweens and settled
  springs re-rendered ~60×/s forever (`Signal::set` always notifies
  subscribers). Finished and paused engines now park the loop and zero
  frames are scheduled until the animation is reactivated.
- **One engine per component.** `use_tween`, `use_spring`, `use_timeline`,
  `use_keyframes`, `use_motion`, and `use_drag` create the engine and
  control handle once inside `use_hook`. Previously every render built a
  fresh engine plus `Arc<Mutex<…>>` while only the first render's loop was
  running; `play()`, `seek()`, and `set_target()` calls from later renders
  silently drove an engine nothing was animating.
- **Handle methods wake parked loops:** `play()`, `resume()`, `reset()`,
  `seek()`, `reverse()`, `set_target()`, `animate_to()`, `spring_to()`,
  `keyframes()`, and drag release inertia. The web rAF loop parks the same
  way via a resumption thunk.
- **New:** `TweenHandle::is_playing()` and `TimelineHandle::is_playing()`.
- No public API was removed or renamed; std-mode users are unaffected
  apart from the intended re-render fix.

### Reproduction from #57

```rust
use animato::dioxus::use_tween;
use animato::Easing;
use dioxus::prelude::*;

#[component]
fn App() -> Element {
    let (x, _h) = use_tween(0.0_f32, 100.0, |b| b.duration(1.0).easing(Easing::EaseOutCubic));
    rsx! { div { "x = {x():.1}" } }
}
```

Before v1.7.4 the window stopped responding after mount. After v1.7.4 the
value counts 0→100, the window stays interactive, and re-renders stop once
the tween completes.

### Building

```toml
[dependencies]
animato = { version = "1.7.4", features = ["dioxus-desktop"] }
dioxus = { version = "0.7.9", default-features = false, features = ["desktop", "launch"] }
```

---

_All workspace crates are versioned together at `1.7.4` in this release._
